## Details

<a id="read_keys"></a>
### [`read_keys`](../../../../src/input/keyboard.asm#L6) `$923B`

*routine*

Reads the keyboard once a pass of the main loop. F1 set-up and players, F7 start, F3 music or effects, F5 pause, CTRL+V version, Q quit. A joystick in port 1 acts as keys: left is CTRL, right is F7, fire is F1.
